name: LFM2.5 2.6B Q8_0 on one Intel Arc Pro B70

library.summary: Liquid AI's compact LFM2.5 2.6B on one Arc Pro B70 in 8-bit form with stock, unpatched llama.cpp - the simplest single-command recipe on the site.
library.benchmark_status: The 132.351606/132.467576 varied-suite observations and objective canary summary are preserved in the guide, but their raw operating-point and canary JSON files are not closed in this repository. Import and hash-bind those files, then replay the quality/determinism gate before assigning a strict headline.

contributors.name: neural.download lab
contributors.contribution: Intake verification, bring-up, baselines, depth sweep, operating point, canary battery, package.
contributors.validated_effect: Stock-upstream characterization; no lab patches in this package.

performance_profiles.label: Raw decode over existing context depth
performance_profiles.scope: llama-bench raw engine rates (pp2048/tg128, fa on, 5 reps); see depth-sweep.svg and sweep JSON in the guide directory. The directly measured zero-depth point remains in the linked raw evidence; no missing depth is interpolated.

known_limitations: Emits untagged reasoning prose before final answers regardless of the reasoning flag; answers correct but verbose.
Canary battery is objective self-consistency only; no cross-model oracle.
Clean-host beginner flow not yet executed.

runtime.build: cmake -G Ninja -B build-sycl-aot-bmg-g31 -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER=icpx -DCMAKE_C_COMPILER=icx -DGGML_SYCL=ON -DGGML_SYCL_F16=ON -DGGML_SYCL_DEVICE_ARCH=bmg_g31 -DGGML_SYCL_MAX_PARALLEL_LINK_JOBS=32 -DLLAMA_CURL=OFF && cmake --build build-sycl-aot-bmg-g31 --target llama-server llama-bench -j 24

commands.launch: BUILD_DIR/bin/llama-server --model $MODEL_DIR/LFM2.5-2.6B-Q8_0.gguf --alias lfm25 --reasoning off --ctx-size 8192 --cache-type-k f16 --cache-type-v f16 --device SYCL0 --gpu-layers 99 --flash-attn auto --parallel 1 --cache-ram 0 --ctx-checkpoints 0 --fit off --metrics --no-webui --host 127.0.0.1 --port 18100
commands.benchmark: python3 scripts/bench-openai-realistic-suite.py --base-url http://127.0.0.1:18100 --model lfm25 --api-mode completions --suite repro/qwen36-27b-autoround-int4-b70/realistic-suite-v1.json --max-tokens 512 --metric-tokens 100 --seed 1 --request-extra-json '{"cache_prompt":false,"seed":42,"temperature":0}' --out bench.json
